title: Warehouse Speed
short: Speed up unloading at the ramp.
long: Increases worker movement/unload speed in the warehouse, clearing ramp backups faster and improving cash conversion during bursts.

title: Warehouse Capacity
short: Store more crates at the ramp.
long: Raises the number/size of crates the warehouse can buffer, preventing overflow while mines and elevator are streaming.

title: Loading Efficiency
long: Cuts animation/handling time for each load cycle, smoothing throughput when paired with speed boosts.

title: Elevator Speed
long: Increases vertical transport speed, the usual first choke. Pair with Lilly's beam for maximum effect.

title: Elevator Cost Reduction
long: Reduces elevator level costs. Equip while buying several E levels to stretch cash (e.g., Damian Jones).

title: Mineshaft Speed
long: Increases mining/return speed. Use when feeding the elevator ahead of a burst.

title: Ore Extraction Rate
long: Boosts the amount extracted per haul. Synergizes with beams/finishers for bigger bursts.

title: Drill Power
long: Speeds through rock tiles to deepen the mine more quickly during pushes.

title: Transport Multiplier
long: Multiplies the value/size of delivered loads at intervals. Great while streaming with Thalia/Lilly.

title: Global Cost Reduction
long: Reduces costs across departments (where applicable). Use only while spending heavily.

title: Global Income
long: Flat multiplier to overall income—steady value during idle stretches.
